index.description: L2 index of methodologies in the frontend domain. The retriever reads this after picking frontend from L1 domains.xml. Entries list slug + tier + summary, plus any <assumes> from the leaf's meta.json — a methodology to load first, and why. Open the leaf meta.json / content/*.xml for full payload.

methodology.summary: Per-screen accessibility audit checklist running 9 critical WCAG-AA checks (semantic landmarks, focus order, contrast, alt text, ARIA correctness, keyboard nav, error messaging, motion-respect, screen-reader labels); produces a per-screen pass/fail row set with named fixes.
